verses.text: Some time later, Egypt’s king got offended by his chief cupbearer and chief baker. ⚠️
Pharaoh was angry with both officers—the chief cupbearer and the chief baker. 😠
He locked them up in the captain of the guard’s house, in the prison where Joseph was being held. ⛓️
The captain assigned Joseph to look after them. They stayed in prison for quite a while. 🔑
One night, both men had dreams—the king of Egypt’s cupbearer and baker, each dream carrying its own meaning while they were locked up. 🌙
Joseph came to them in the morning, took one look, and saw they were down. 😟
He asked Pharaoh’s officers, who were in custody with him in his master’s house, “Why are you looking so sad today?” 💬
They told him, “We both had dreams, and nobody can explain them.” Joseph replied, “Don’t interpretations belong to God? Tell me what you dreamed.” 🙏
The chief cupbearer told Joseph his dream: “In my dream, there was a vine right in front of me. 🍇
“The vine had three branches. It budded, blossomed, and grew bunches of ripe grapes. 🌿
“Pharaoh’s cup was in my hand. I took the grapes, squeezed them into his cup, and put the cup in Pharaoh’s hand.” 🍷
Joseph told him, “Here’s what it means: the three branches stand for three days. 📖
“In three days, Pharaoh will restore you to your position. You’ll put his cup back in his hand, just like you did when you were his cupbearer. 👑
“When things go well for you, please remember me. Show me some kindness: mention me to Pharaoh and get me out of this prison. 🙏
“I was stolen from the land of the Hebrews, and even here I did nothing to deserve being thrown into this dungeon.” ⛓️
When the chief baker saw that Joseph’s interpretation sounded good, he told him, “I had a dream too: there were three baskets of white bread on my head. 🍞
“The top basket held all kinds of baked food for Pharaoh, but birds were eating it right out of the basket on my head.” 🐦
Joseph answered, “Here’s what your dream means: the three baskets are three days. 📖
“In three days, Pharaoh will lift your head off you and hang you on a tree. Then birds will eat your flesh.” ⚖️
On the third day—Pharaoh’s birthday—he held a feast for all his servants. In front of them, he brought out the chief cupbearer and chief baker. 🎂
He restored the chief cupbearer to his job, and the cup went back into Pharaoh’s hand. 🍷
But Pharaoh hanged the chief baker, exactly as Joseph had interpreted. ⚖️
Still, the chief cupbearer didn’t remember Joseph. He forgot him. 🕯️
